description: Constructed Deposit Closeout scenarios with hand-specified expected fields.

cases.name: Known tenant and owner costs with unresolved third item
behavioralAssertions: Preserve the supported repair; exclude owner painting; identify the precise missing cost/responsibility question.
No final refund or full-withholding assumption.

cases.name: Ordinary final-ready counterpart

value.description: Final additional actual damage accepted for test
value.reason: 15000 actual tenant damage and its chosen amount are accepted test inputs.

value.excerpt: Final actual damage of 15000 cents, tenant responsibility and allowability stipulated for this test.

acceptedAssumptions: No prior movements or other balances
All legal/causation predicates are explicitly synthetic
behavioralAssertions: Do not invent document requests or use interim routing when final work is ready.
Final-ready is not approved, issued or financially settled.
Amounts are hand-specified from the design, not generated by a review implementation.

cases.name: Trigger not established despite known source dates

value.reason: Relevant trigger interpretation not accepted; do not infer a maximum of dates.

acceptedAssumptions: Separate source events do not automatically establish the legal trigger
behavioralAssertions: No definitive legal due date; preparation remains available.
Name the missing trigger fact or interpretation and its resolver.

cases.name: Explicit synthetic interim qualification; money treatment unresolved

patches.value: For this constructed test only, inability to determine claim extent within the ordinary period is separately stipulated; a missing invoice alone is not the reason.

acceptedAssumptions: Interim qualifying condition independently stipulated as a test input
behavioralAssertions: Prepare supported interim work and contractor follow-up, subject to explicit synthetic labeling.
Surface INTERIM_MONEY as an unresolved policy question; no assumed full withholding or payment eligibility.
Synthetic ordinary and final dates are 2026-10-02 and 2026-11-01 respectively; these are not verified legal conclusions.

cases.name: Missing invoice alone is nonqualifying delay

patches.value: Only a missing invoice is supplied; no separate qualifying condition is established.

behavioralAssertions: Do not offer an automatic extension; keep the ordinary synthetic 2026-10-02 requirement active.
Missing approval or invoice does not stop time.

cases.name: Unsupported jurisdiction does not inherit NC law
acceptedAssumptions: General record shape may be reused, substantive NC decisions may not
behavioralAssertions: No NC deadline or final substantive legal answer; retain useful preparation.

cases.name: Final amounts known but recipient route missing
acceptedAssumptions: Known account amounts do not supply a recipient route or missing-address rule
behavioralAssertions: No last-payer or email default; block affected dispatch/refund request.
Track the distinct missing-address/route branch; do not declare completion or invent retention duration.

cases.name: Recorded balance inclusion basis unresolved
acceptedAssumptions: Recorded number alone does not resolve inclusion of prior transactions
behavioralAssertions: Ask Accounting for the balance basis and included transactions; no double counting or assumed zero prior movement.

cases.name: One-input clock change preserves arithmetic and exposes overdue work
acceptedAssumptions: Only reviewClock differs from NC-A-002; nothing was issued or paid
behavioralAssertions: Expose overdue synthetic ordinary work without changing historical dates, inventing dispatch, or silently switching to interim routing.
